Approve a trail.

<trail> is a project trail number, ID, or <repo>/<number>. Without one, follow the current branch's
parent. --repo and --branch select a working context. Only that branch is approved,
not every repository on the trail. The branch work must be open.

Usage:
  entire trail approve [<trail>] [flags]

Flags:
      --branch string    Select a repository branch within the trail
  -h, --help             help for approve
  -m, --message string   Optional approval comment

Global Flags:
      --context name     Act as this saved login name for this command only — including the git and agent processes it spawns — instead of the active context (entire auth contexts lists them)
      --project string   Project as gh/<owner> or et/<project>; required for list, otherwise defaults to the repository's namespace
      --repo string      Target repository as forge/owner/repo (e.g. gh/acme/app) or a clone URL; for list, only filters the required --project
